ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by approximately 60% high-intensity pixels (white/light gray) and 40% low-intensity pixels (black/dark gray) forming a mottled pattern.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Discontinuous, irregular dark elliptical and circular blobs distributed across both lobes; highest density of dark pigmentation is observed at the tips and along the leading edges, with larger white contiguous zones in the medial regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire trailing edge of both lobes; left lobe exhibits deep V-shaped notches while the right lobe displays more rounded, low-amplitude wave-like peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to distinct, upward-tapering convex distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark-on-white pixel clusters (5-15px diameter) concentrated on the right lobe; left lobe exhibits smaller white-on-black spotting near the leading edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, near-vertical dark linear markings are visible on the medial-inner section of the right lobe, cutting through the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent yellowish-white calcified cluster (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme distal tip of the left lobe.
